note: Rough guide compiled from well-known failure patterns. Costs are typical independent-workshop ranges in the Baltics (parts + labour). Always confirm with a pre-purchase inspection.

volkswagen|up.summary: Simple, cheap city car. The 1.0 MPI 3-cyl does ~5 L/100 km and has few big failures; strong demand in LV.
good: Belt-driven 1.0 MPI is simple and cheap to fix
Shares everything with Skoda Citigo / Seat Mii
Holds value well — easy to resell

watch.t: ASG automated manual (auto versions) is jerky; clutch-actuator faults
e-up!: get a battery state-of-health (SoH) report
CNG EcoFuel: check gas-tank inspection date; few CNG stations in LV

toyota|corolla.summary: One of the most reliable used cars. Petrol 1.4/1.6 VVT-i and the hybrids routinely pass 300k km. Avoid the 2005-2009 2.0/2.2 D-4D diesels.
good: Petrol VVT-i engines are close to indestructible
Cheap parts, easy resale in LV

toyota|corolla-verso.summary: Practical 7-seat Corolla. Petrol versions are robust; diesel 2.2 D-4D (2006-2009) and MMT gearboxes are the weak spots.

toyota|avensis.summary: Durable and comfortable. Best with 1.8/2.0 petrol. 2.0/2.2 D-4D (2006-2009) diesels suffer head-gasket/oil-burning issues.
good: 1.8/2.0 petrol and later 2.0 D-4D (2010+) are good

watch.t: Rear suspension arms & front wishbone bushes

toyota|yaris.summary: Cheap, reliable small car. Manual petrol versions are the safe bet; MMT automated manual is not.

toyota|aygo.summary: 1.0 1KR petrol is very reliable; budget car build quality. Same car as Citroen C1 / Peugeot 107.

watch.t: Rust: rear arches & tailgate on older ones

toyota|rav4.summary: Reliable SUV; petrol and hybrid excellent. Avoid the 2.2 D-4D (2006-2009).

toyota|prius.summary: Taxi-proven hybrid. Engine, gearbox and brakes last very long; age-related battery is the main bill.
good: No clutch, no starter motor, no DMF

toyota|land-cruiser.summary: Built to last. 3.0 D-4D needs injector care; check frame rust underneath.

watch.t: Frame & underbody rust — inspect on a lift

lexus|rx.summary: RX 400h/450h hybrids are robust luxury SUVs; check hybrid battery age and brake actuator.
good: Toyota hybrid reliability in a luxury car

lexus|is.summary: Petrol IS is reliable; the IS 220d (2AD diesel) shares Toyota's head-gasket/oil problem — avoid.

volkswagen|golf.summary: Huge parts supply and easy to sell. Engine choice decides everything: 1.6 MPI, 1.9 TDI and 1.6/2.0 TDI common-rail are safe; early 1.4 TSI and some 2.0 TDI PD are risky.

volkswagen|passat.summary: B5 1.9 TDI is legendary but old. B6 (2005-2010) has the weak 2.0 TDI PD and oil-burning TFSI. B7/B8 with 1.6/2.0 TDI common-rail are much safer.

volkswagen|polo.summary: 1.4 16v petrol and 1.6 TDI are fine; avoid the 1.2 3-cyl (6V/12V) and early DSG7.

volkswagen|touran.summary: Great family MPV with Golf mechanicals. 1.9/2.0 TDI and 1.6 TDI CR are best; avoid the 2007-2010 1.4 TSI twincharger.

volkswagen|caddy.summary: Workhorse. 1.9 TDI and 1.6/2.0 TDI CR are durable; check for hard work-van use.

watch.t: Ex-work vans: check clutch, rear springs and interior wear

volkswagen|transporter.summary: T5 2.5 TDI (2003-2009) has camshaft/head problems; 1.9 TDI and 2.0 TDI CR (2010+) are better. Rust check essential.

watch.t: T5 2.5 TDI: camshaft/lifters, EGR, cracked head

volkswagen|tiguan.summary: 2.0 TDI CR is the pick. Early 1.4 TSI and 2.0 TFSI have chain/oil issues; Haldex AWD needs oil changes.

watch.t: Haldex AWD coupling: oil + filter every 60k km or the pump fails

volkswagen|sharan.summary: Practical, but sliding doors, DSG and 2.0 TDI PD (old model) add risk.

volkswagen|touareg.summary: Expensive to fix: air suspension, transfer case, 2.5 R5 and 3.0 V6 TDI chains.

skoda|octavia.summary: Octavia 1/2 with 1.9 TDI or 1.6 MPI is about the cheapest bulletproof Baltic car. 1.4/1.8 TSI from 2008-2012 have chain issues.
good: Huge boot, cheap parts, great resale on ss.lv

skoda|fabia.summary: 1.4 16v petrol and 1.9 TDI are good. The 1.2 HTP 3-cyl is the one to avoid.

skoda|superb.summary: Huge and comfortable; with 1.9/2.0 TDI CR it is a high-km hero. Watch DSG and early TSI.

skoda|rapid.summary: Simple, cheap. 1.2 TSI (2013+ EA211) and 1.6 TDI are fine.

skoda|yeti.summary: Good with 2.0 TDI CR; 1.2/1.4 TSI before 2013 have chain issues; Haldex on 4x4.

audi|a3.summary: Golf underneath. Same engine rules: TDI common-rail good, early TSI/TFSI risky, DSG7 caution.

audi|a4.summary: Multitronic CVT (FWD automatics), oil-burning 1.8/2.0 TFSI and some 2.0 TDI PD make the wrong A4 expensive. Quattro manual or 2.0 TDI CR (2008+) are the safer picks.

audi|a6.summary: Comfortable, but Multitronic, 2.7/3.0 TDI timing chains and air suspension (allroad) can be costly.
good: 3.0 TDI quattro is strong if chains are done

audi|q5.summary: 2.0 TDI CR fine; 2.0 TFSI (2008-2012) oil consumption; S-tronic DL501 mechatronic.

audi|q7.summary: Heavy and complex: air suspension, 3.0 TDI chains, big brakes. Buy only with history.

bmw|3-series.summary: Great to drive. N47 2.0d (2007-2014) timing chain is the big one; 6-cyl diesels (M57/N57) are strong. Oil leaks are normal past 150k.

watch.t: Oil filter housing & valve cover gasket leaks

bmw|5-series.summary: 520d (N47) chain risk; 530d/525d (M57/N57) strong. Touring rear air springs and E60 electrics.

bmw|x3.summary: E83/F25 xDrive transfer case is the classic fault; 20d has the N47 chain.

bmw|x5.summary: Transfer case, air suspension, cooling system and big-car running costs. 3.0d engines themselves are strong.

mercedes|c-class.summary: W203 (2000-2007) rusts; W204 (2007-2014) much better. Diesel injectors and 7G-Tronic valve body are the typical bills.
good: W204 C220/C250 CDI good highway cars

watch.t: Rust: W203 wheel arches, boot lid, door bottoms

mercedes|e-class.summary: W211 2002-2006: SBC brakes & rust. W212 (2009+) solid. OM642 V6 oil-cooler leak, OM651 injectors.
good: W212 E220/E250 CDI are durable taxis

mercedes|b-class.summary: W245 rusts and has CVT (Autotronic) issues; W246 better but 1.5 dCi/1.8 CDI quirks.

mercedes|ml.summary: Air suspension, OM642 oil cooler, transfer case — expensive if neglected.

mercedes|vito.summary: Work vans: rust, injectors, and hard previous lives.

watch.t: Rust: sills, door bottoms, rear arches

ford|focus.summary: Mk2 1.6 petrol is cheap and solid. Mk3 Powershift automatic (2011-2016) — avoid. 1.6 TDCi turbos and 1.0 EcoBoost cooling need checking.

ford|fiesta.summary: 1.25/1.4 petrol simple and reliable; avoid Powershift and watch 1.0 EcoBoost coolant leaks.

ford|mondeo.summary: 2.0 petrol good; 2.0 TDCi needs DPF/injector care; Mk4 rear subframe/arch rust.

ford|s-max.summary: 2.0 TDCi + Powershift 6DCT450 is OK if serviced; check DMF and DPF.

ford|kuga.summary: 2.0 TDCi fine; 1.5/1.6 EcoBoost (2013-2019) had overheating/coolant recalls.

watch.t: 1.5/1.6 EcoBoost: coolant loss / overheating recall — check it was done

opel|astra.summary: Astra H 1.6 petrol is OK; 1.9 CDTI swirl flaps/EGR and Easytronic gearbox are the problems. Astra J 1.4T/1.7 CDTI fine.

opel|insignia.summary: 2.0 CDTI (A20DTH) DMF/EGR/DPF and the 6-speed automatic are common bills.

watch.t: 6-speed automatic (Aisin AF40): harsh shifts, valve body

opel|zafira.summary: Zafira B: 1.9 CDTI and blower-resistor fire recall (check done). Petrol 1.6/1.8 simpler.

watch.t: Heater blower resistor (fire recall 2015) — check recall done

opel|corsa.summary: Corsa D 1.2/1.4 timing chain stretch; Easytronic robot gearbox — avoid.

opel|vectra.summary: Vectra C 1.9 CDTI issues and rust; cheap for a reason.

honda|civic.summary: 8th gen 1.8 i-VTEC is tough; rear wheel bearings and the i-SHIFT robot gearbox are the weak points. 2.2 i-CTDi has manifold cracks.

honda|accord.summary: 2.0/2.4 petrol are excellent; 2.2 i-CTDi (2004-2008) manifold & DMF.

honda|cr-v.summary: Reliable SUV; 3rd gen (2007-2012) A/C compressor failure is a classic.

honda|jazz.summary: Very reliable small car. Old CVT automatics (2002-2008) can judder — manuals are bulletproof.

mazda|6.summary: Petrol versions are reliable but rust (arches, sills). Diesels (2.0/2.2) suffer oil dilution — avoid for city use.

mazda|3.summary: 1.6 petrol good; rust on BK/BL; 1.6 diesel is the PSA DV6 (turbo).

mazda|cx-5.summary: Petrol Skyactiv-G is good; 2.2 Skyactiv-D needs long drives (oil dilution).

mazda|2.summary: Simple petrol supermini; check rust on older ones.

nissan|qashqai.summary: J10 1.5 dCi bearing failures, 2.0 petrol CVT, J11 1.2 DIG-T oil use. 1.6 dCi (2011+) is the better pick.

nissan|leaf.summary: Battery has no active cooling — capacity loss is the whole story. Check SoH / battery bars.

hyundai|i30.summary: 1.4/1.6 MPI petrol and 1.6 CRDi are reliable; early 1.6 GDi carbon/piston issues.

hyundai|ix35.summary: 2.0 CRDi durable; 4WD coupling and turbo at high km.

volvo|v70.summary: D5 5-cyl diesels are durable; watch swirl flaps (early D5), AWD angle gear and Geartronic shifting.

volvo|xc90.summary: Gen-1 XC90 (2002-2014): AWD angle gear and auto gearbox are the classic bills. D5 engine itself is strong.

volvo|v50.summary: Focus-based; 2.0D (PSA) is fine, 1.6D needs turbo care.

volvo|v40.summary: Modern V40 (2012+) is reliable with D2/D3/T3.

renault|megane.summary: Electrics, 1.5 dCi bearings and 1.2 TCe oil burning. 1.6 16v petrol is the safe engine.

renault|laguna.summary: Electrics and 1.9/2.0 dCi problems; cheap for a reason.

dacia|duster.summary: Simple and cheap; 1.5 dCi bearings and weak underbody rust protection.

peugeot|308.summary: 1.6 THP and 1.2 PureTech are risky; 1.6 HDi turbo/injector seals. 2.0 HDi is the robust choice.

citroen|c5.summary: Hydractive suspension spheres/pumps and PSA engines.

subaru|forester.summary: AWD is tough. 2.5 EJ head gaskets, FB oil use (2011-2014), early 2.0D crankshaft, CVT judder.

watch.t: Keep all 4 tyres the same wear — AWD damage otherwise

mitsubishi|outlander.summary: 2.0/2.4 petrol robust. PHEV: check battery capacity. 2.2 DI-D: DPF.

mitsubishi|lancer.summary: Simple and reliable; rust is the main enemy.

fiat|500.summary: 1.2 petrol simple; 0.9 TwinAir sensitive; Dualogic robot gearbox — avoid.

mini|cooper.summary: R56 (2006-2013) 1.4/1.6 petrol: timing chain and oil consumption. F56 (2014+) much better.

tesla|model-3.summary: Drivetrain is reliable and battery is under 8-yr warranty; check SoH, upper control arms, paint/panel gaps.

tesla|model-s.summary: Early cars (2012-2016): drive unit, MCU1 screen memory, door handles. Check warranty status.

land-rover|range-rover-sport.summary: Air suspension, TDV6 crankshaft, electrics — only with full history and budget.

land-rover|freelander.summary: Freelander 2: rear diff/Haldex and 2.2 TD4 issues.

issues.t: Timing chain stretch / tensioner — rattle on cold start; can jump timing
1.4 TSI twincharger (Golf GT, Touran, Tiguan 2007-2010): piston/ring failures
Oil consumption, turbo wastegate rattle

engines.label: 1.8/2.0 TFSI (EA888 gen1-2, 2007-2013)

issues.t: Oil consumption from piston rings (up to 1 L/1000 km)
Timing chain tensioner (pre-2013 type) — failure wrecks the engine
Water pump / thermostat housing leak, PCV valve

good: Fine if pistons/rings and tensioner were updated — ask for invoices

engines.label: 1.0/1.2/1.4/1.5 TSI & 1.0 MPI (EA211, 2012+)

issues.t: Coolant leak: plastic thermostat housing / water pump
Timing belt + water pump (if not proven done)

good: Belt-driven, much more reliable than the old chain TSI

issues.t: Weak timing chain / tensioner — chain jump bends valves
Burnt valves, misfires, coil packs

engines.label: 1.9 TDI (PD/VE)

issues.t: Timing belt every 90-120k km (PD) — budget it if no proof
Dual-mass flywheel + clutch
Unit injectors / injector loom (PD), turbo vanes sticking

good: One of the most durable diesels ever — 400-500k km is normal

engines.label: 2.0 TDI PD (2003-2009)

issues.t: Cracked cylinder head (16v BKD/BMM)
Oil-pump hex drive shaft wear on balance-shaft versions (Passat B6, A4/A6: BKP/BLB/BRE) — sudden oil loss
Injectors, DPF (BMM/BMP), DMF

good: Fine if the oil-pump shaft upgrade was done

engines.label: 1.6/2.0 TDI common-rail (EA189/EA288, 2008+)

issues.t: EGR valve / cooler, DPF clogging on short trips
Timing belt + water pump (if not done)
Dual-mass flywheel + clutch

good: Durable — 300k+ km common with highway use

engines.label: 2.7/3.0 TDI V6 (2004-2011)

issues.t: Timing chains at the back of the engine stretch
Intake swirl-flap motors, injectors

good: Strong and smooth when chains are healthy

issues.t: Camshaft / lifter wear, cracked head, EGR
Mechatronic unit failure (worst 2008-2013)
Clutch-pack judder when pulling away
Needs DSG oil every 60k km — ask for proof
Occasional mechatronic faults

engines.label: Multitronic CVT (FWD automatic)

issues.t: Chain/clutch pack and control-unit failures — expensive

good: Quattro automatics use Tiptronic instead — much safer

engines.label: 1.8 VVT-i (1ZZ-FE, 1999-2007)

issues.t: Oil consumption from piston rings (2000-2005) — check oil level and smoke

good: Keeps running even when burning oil — just top up

issues.t: Head-gasket failure & heavy oil consumption (block damage on 2.2)
EGR & DPF (D-CAT) clogging
Injectors / high-pressure pump
Dual-mass flywheel
Clutch actuator / learning problems, jerky shifts

engines.label: Toyota/Lexus hybrid (HSD)

issues.t: HV battery near end of life after ~12-15 years
Prius 2 (2004-2009): brake actuator, inverter coolant pump
1.8 hybrid (2010-2015): EGR cooler clog can lead to head gasket

good: No clutch, starter or DMF; brakes last ages

engines.label: 2.0d N47 (2007-2014)

issues.t: Timing chain (gearbox side) stretch — rattle at idle; engine out to fix
Swirl flaps / intake, DMF

good: Fine if chain kit was replaced — ask for invoice

engines.label: M47/M57 diesel (before 2008)

issues.t: Swirl flaps can break into the engine — check they were removed/blanked
Turbo, injectors

good: M57 3.0d is one of the best diesels BMW made

issues.t: Timing chain at very high mileage, EGR
Piezo injectors & ignition coils — misfires

engines.label: 7G-Tronic automatic (2004-2013)

issues.t: Conductor plate / valve body — limp mode

good: Durable with oil changes every ~60-100k km

generic.t: Imported car: check odometer history (carVertical / autoDNA, service book, inspection records)
Very low km for its age — possible rollback, verify history
Mileage not stated — ask before going further
High-km diesel: DMF+clutch, injectors, turbo, DPF/EGR — budget unless receipts show they're done
Ask for timing belt/chain + water pump proof
Automatic gearbox: ask when the fluid was changed; worn boxes cost a lot
Rust check: sills, arches, subframes, brake lines (LV tehniskā apskate is strict)
Suspension bushes, wheel bearings, A/C compressor wear
